ex.en: I only had time to skim the report.
ex.zh: 我只有時間大略看一下報告。

ex.en: Skim the article first, then read it carefully.
ex.zh: 先略讀文章，再仔細閱讀。

ex.en: Skim the fat off the soup before serving.
ex.zh: 上菜前把湯上的浮油撇掉。

ex.en: She skimmed the foam from the top of the pot.
ex.zh: 她把鍋子表面的浮沫撈掉。

ex.en: I'd like a latte with skim milk, please.
ex.zh: 我要一杯脫脂牛奶拿鐵，謝謝。

ex.en: Skim milk has less fat than whole milk.
ex.zh: 脫脂牛奶的脂肪比全脂牛奶少。

ex.en: Can you skate?
ex.zh: 你會溜冰嗎？

ex.en: Is it safe to skate on this lake?
ex.zh: 在這個湖上溜冰安全嗎？

ex.en: Don't forget your ice skates.
ex.zh: 別忘了拿溜冰鞋。

ex.en: I got the roller skates for nothing.
ex.zh: 我免費拿到了一雙溜冰鞋。

ex.en: I think skateboards are usually cheaper than rollerblades.
ex.zh: 我覺得滑板通常比直排輪便宜。

ex.en: He rides his skateboard to school.
ex.zh: 他踩滑板上學。

ex.en: Do you skateboard?
ex.zh: 你玩滑板嗎？

ex.en: The kids skateboard in the park every day.
ex.zh: 孩子們每天在公園玩滑板。

ex.en: Jiro made a sketch of Mt. Fuji.
ex.zh: 次郎畫了一幅富士山的素描。

ex.en: The architect showed us a rough sketch of the building.
ex.zh: 建築師給我們看了大樓的草圖。

ex.en: Tom sketched a picture of an elephant for Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆畫了一張大象素描給瑪麗。

ex.en: Can you sketch it for me on this piece of paper please?
ex.zh: 可以請你在這張紙上幫我畫個草圖嗎？

ex.en: Let me sketch out the plan for you.
ex.zh: 我來為你概略說明這個計畫。

ex.en: The manager sketched out the new strategy at the meeting.
ex.zh: 經理在會議上概述了新策略。

ex.en: We're very skeptical.
ex.zh: 我們非常懷疑。

ex.en: Many people are skeptical about the actual effects of traditional Chinese medicine.
ex.zh: 很多人對中藥的實際療效抱持懷疑態度。

ex.en: My manager is skeptical about the new plan.
ex.zh: 我的主管對新計畫持保留態度。

skeptic.zh: 懷疑者、抱持懷疑態度的人

ex.en: I was a skeptic at first, but the product really works.
ex.zh: 我起初很懷疑，但這個產品真的有效。

ex.en: Skeptics doubt the plan will succeed.
ex.zh: 持懷疑態度的人認為這個計畫不會成功。

ex.en: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
ex.zh: 英語流利是現今很搶手的技能。

ex.en: You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
ex.zh: 你要學的是真本事，而不只是表面的知識。

ex.en: Her acute observation skills make her a very suitable photographer.
ex.zh: 她敏銳的觀察力讓她很適合當攝影師。

ex.en: Skin shouldn't be exposed to sunlight for too long.
ex.zh: 皮膚不該長時間曝曬在陽光下。

ex.en: Staying up late is terrible for your skin.
ex.zh: 熬夜對皮膚很不好。

ex.en: This medicine will cure you of your skin disease.
ex.zh: 這藥可以治好你的皮膚病。

ex.en: Please scrape the skin off the potatoes.
ex.zh: 請把馬鈴薯的皮削掉。

ex.en: Banana skins can be very slippery.
ex.zh: 香蕉皮可能很滑。

ex.en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
ex.zh: 你曾經夢想過在天空飛翔嗎？

ex.en: I saw a white cloud sailing across the sky.
ex.zh: 我看到一朵白雲飄過天空。

ex.en: Living in the city makes me miss starry night skies the most.
ex.zh: 住在城市裡，我最懷念的是夜晚的星空。

ex.en: I like this skirt. May I try it on?
ex.zh: 我喜歡這件裙子，可以試穿嗎？

ex.en: Long skirts are out of fashion now.
ex.zh: 現在長裙過時了。

ex.en: I would like to try the blue striped skirt.
ex.zh: 我想試穿那件藍色條紋裙。

ex.en: The minister skirted the question.
ex.zh: 部長迴避了這個問題。

ex.en: Don't skirt around the issue.
ex.zh: 別迴避這個問題。

ex.en: Is this the first time that you've ever skied?
ex.zh: 這是你第一次滑雪嗎？

ex.en: He skis in Hokkaido every winter.
ex.zh: 他每年冬天都去北海道滑雪。

ex.en: We went skiing in Japan last winter.
ex.zh: 我們去年冬天去日本滑雪。

ex.en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.
ex.zh: 我想買一雙滑雪靴。

ex.en: You can rent skis at the ski resort.
ex.zh: 你可以在滑雪場租滑雪板。

ex.en: Jane skipped the questions she couldn't answer.
ex.zh: 珍跳過了她不會回答的問題。

ex.en: Let's skip the introduction and start the meeting.
ex.zh: 我們跳過開場介紹，直接開會吧。

ex.en: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
ex.zh: 偶爾不吃早餐也沒什麼大不了。

ex.en: Do you know why he skipped class today?
ex.zh: 你知道他今天為什麼翹課嗎？

ex.en: She is skipping rope.
ex.zh: 她在跳繩。

ex.en: The children skipped happily down the street.
ex.zh: 孩子們開心地沿街蹦蹦跳跳。
